### ZarfClusterAgeEncryption

records the age recipients a document's credentials were encrypted to.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property       | Type              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lastModified` | `string`          | no       |         | is when cargoship last rewrote the credentials in this document, in RFC 3339.                                                                                                   |

### ZarfClusterConfig

holds cluster-wide configuration.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property       | Type                                                     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `loadbalancer` | `string`                                                 | yes      |         | is the hostname clients use to reach the cluster control plane.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `profiles`     | map[string][ZarfClusterProfiles](#zarfclusterprofiles)   | no       |         | maps a profile name to host and engine overrides that a host can select.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `registries`   | array of [ZarfClusterRegistries](#zarfclusterregistries) | no       |         | lists the container registries the cluster uses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `values`       | object                                                   | no       |         | overrides the values the distro package was built with. It is the same<br>nested structure the package ships, addressed by the same dotted paths, and it<br>must still satisfy the package's values schema. Keys the package does not<br>define are kept, so a cluster can carry values a later package version reads. |

</div>

### ZarfClusterEncryption

records how the credentials in a document were encrypted.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property | Type                                                  | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `age`    | [ZarfClusterAgeEncryption](#zarfclusterageencryption) | no       |         | records the age recipients this document's credentials were encrypted to. Nothing verifies this list and nothing can: an age header carries no recipient identifier, so editing it changes what the file claims and not a byte of what it holds. |

### ZarfFirewallPolicyConfig

configures a firewalld policy that opens ports from one zone to another.

### ZarfFirewallRule

is a single backend-neutral firewall rule.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property      | Type                  | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `action`      | `string`              | yes      |         | is what cargoship does with traffic that matches the rule. One of `allow`, `deny`, `reject`.                                                                         |
| `destination` | `string`              | no       |         | is the address or CIDR the traffic goes to.                                                                                                                          |
| `direction`   | `string`              | no       | `in`    | selects which traffic the rule matches. It defaults to in. One of `in`, `out`, `forward`.                                                                            |
| `egress`      | `string`              | no       |         | names where forward traffic leaves. It is a zone on firewalld hosts and an<br>interface on ufw hosts. It applies to forward rules only.                              |
| `ingress`     | `string`              | no       |         | names where forward traffic enters. It is a zone on firewalld hosts and an<br>interface on ufw hosts. It applies to forward rules only.                              |
| `name`        | `string`              | no       |         | identifies the rule. Cargoship uses it to name the artifacts it writes on the<br>node, so it must be unique within a host. Cargoship generates one when it is empty. |
| `port`        | `string` or `integer` | no       |         | is the port number, or inclusive port range, the rule matches.                                                                                                       |
| `protocol`    | `string`              | no       |         | is the type of traffic the rule matches. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `sctp`, `dccp`.                                                                                        |
| `source`      | `string`              | no       |         | is the address or CIDR the traffic comes from.                                                                                                                       |

</div>

### ZarfHostConfig

defines the configuration for a specific host, including firewall policies and the ports cargoship opens on the node.

<div class="schema-table">

| Property   | Type                                                             | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `firewall` | [ZarfFirewallConfig](#zarffirewallconfig)                        | no       |         | holds the backend-neutral firewall rules cargoship renders onto whichever<br>firewall the node runs, firewalld, ufw, or nftables.                                                       |
| `policy`   | map[string][ZarfFirewallPolicyConfig](#zarffirewallpolicyconfig) | no       |         | maps a policy name to a firewalld policy that allows traffic from one interface to another.<br>It is firewalld-only; prefer forward rules under `firewall.rules` for new configuration. |
| `ports`    | array of [ZarfHostPort](#zarfhostport)                           | no       |         | lists the ports and protocols cargoship opens on the node.                                                                                                                              |
